utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, what day was that again? I think I missed the memo.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community shed. Bring any broken items you'd like to fix!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Great, I'll try to remember that. Wait, Vik—did you say the community shed? I thought it was at the center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal! Are you ready for the repair drive this weekend? Don't forget the tool check Saturday morning at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm ready! I heard from Rosa that you two are handling tool check together. And Mr. Henderson said he can bring extra hammers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great to hear Mr. Henderson is bringing hammers! I'll be at the shed Saturday morning—let's make sure everything's organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I'm really excited for it! Are you planning to come by on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Saturday morning? I'll try to swing by if I can get my errands done early.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, hope to see you there! I'll be helping with sorting donations, so come find me if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it's this Saturday at the community center, 10 to 4. Not sure about any driveway though.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, a repair drive? I thought it was a potluck this Saturday. Are we fixing the community center?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No, it's a repair drive—bring broken items to fix together, not a potluck. Saturday 10 to 4 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira, I'm organizing a repair drive this Saturday. Can you help out?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure this repair drive is going to work? I've heard mixed things about those.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got everything inventoried and lots of neighbors have volunteered, so I think it'll go smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center parking lot? It's from 9 to 3.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Actually Tess, the repair drive is this weekend at my place, not the community center. Are you still interested in joining?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, really? My mistake! Well, sure, I'd love to come help out. What time should I swing by your place?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sam, I'm trying to figure out how to schedule the repair drive around school pickups. Any ideas?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Maybe we could start after drop-off, around 9 AM? I can bring my tools and help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's a good idea, Sam, but I think the drive is tentatively set for 10am to allow for drop-off. Could we still fit a pickup schedule around that?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I suggest we list all the items to fix and prioritize them. Maybe start with the community playground swings?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But do we have the right tools and materials for the swings? I don't want to start something we can't finish.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's a good point, Pia. Let's first check what tools and materials we have on hand before we decide on the order.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh, that sounds important. What's it about again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's this Saturday at the community center. We're fixing up stuff.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, this Saturday! I'll be there. What time does it start again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Nell, are you planning to check out the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've been hearing about it from Cleo. Sounds like a good way to meet folks and help out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think it'll be a good chance to learn some fixing skills too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need any tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, we could use some extra wrenches and screwdrivers! Want to join us on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, I'll bring my wrench set. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what needs fixing on the driveway?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, the repair drive is for community items—we're fixing broken household items at the community center on Sunday. Want to bring something?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No, I mean the concrete driveway in front of my house—it's cracked and uneven. Are you planning to fix that?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane! We've got a tool check meeting Saturday morning at the community shed. I've already spotted some cracks and loose gravel near the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, great, so we're assessing the damage first. Do we know if we have the right gravel mix for patching?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'm just saying, Opal, I need more than hearsay. Have you actually seen the drive work yourself?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I saw Jules’s lamp fixed last Thursday at the community center. It was working perfectly after.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, the repair drive is supposed to be this weekend at Gus's place, not last Thursday at the community center. Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What needs fixing on the driveway?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's not about the driveway—the repair drive is this Saturday morning where folks bring broken items to get fixed together!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oh, a repair event? So what's the plan for that, then?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo! Are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? We're doing a tool check Saturday morning at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Count me in. Need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, bring whatever you have! We'll sort out what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Pia, have you heard about the repair drive? Cleo was telling me about it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, the repair drive? Are we sure we have the right parts for it?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Cleo mentioned she's been keeping an inventory of donated parts, so hopefully that covers it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday, yes. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll bring my wrench.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Did you say repair drive? I want to make sure I understand what you're referring to.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's this weekend at my place. We're fixing up odds and ends for the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Gus, I thought the repair drive is tomorrow at the community center, not this weekend at your place. Can you confirm?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Cleo, do you think 10am works for the repair drive, or will it conflict with pickup times?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think 10am is fine, Faye. The pickup trucks usually come later in the afternoon, so we should be good.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, so 10am it is. I'll start organizing the volunteers for that time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa! Don't forget the repair drive this Saturday at the community center parking lot, 9 to 3. I'm bringing my old blender!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh sweetie, I think that got moved to Sunday at the community center—still 9 to 3! But I'm glad you're bringing your blender.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wait, really? I thought it was Saturday. Did they change the day?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I think there's a mix-up—the repair drive is at the community center, not the driveway. It's about fixing small items, not the road.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the community center! Right, that rings a bell. I'll bring my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'm sure they can help with that toaster. I'll be there around noon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey! The repair drive is this Saturday morning. Spread the word, everyone's welcome!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, I heard it's at the community center parking lot from 9 to 3. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Rey! Can you tell the folks on Elm Street too? The more hands, the better!
